| # clcan_fd_getData {#clcan_fd_getdata-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Get the oldest message (FIFO) from the receive buffer of the specified CAN channel.

 

Remarks:

- Registration of a buffer by function clcan_fd_registerRxBuf() is the prerequisite for this function!

- First check return value before accessing the message.

- Receiving data is only possible if the CAN channel was initialized with clcan_initxt().

 

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:0.8125in;height:0.2604in;border:none"}    CAN Rx IDs: 18DA01FA/18DBFFFA and CAN Tx ID: 18DAFA01 shall not be used for CLAPI communication
